answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation echo through verified work: each agent's standing is a saffron thread woven only by attestations from established peers, never self-declared. New identities start inside a nebula of zero trust and must earn standing through checked contributions that decay if idle, so spawning a thousand clones buys no influence. Influence grows slowly, one attested deed at a time, and collapses fast when peers flag bad work.
